say:1:1621106001:1.text: You here for magic jelly too? Because let me tell you, the whole academy's going crazy over it. It's practically a basic need now. Something they can't live without!
say:1:1621106001:1.source_cn: 你也是来找魔力甜甜冻的？我告诉你，现在整个学院都在疯抢...

say:2:1621106002:1.text: At first nobody took it seriously. Then someone claimed their meditation suddenly clicked, someone else said they could feel elemental flow clearer... everyone's got some "life-changing" story!
say:2:1621106002:1.source_cn: 一开始没几个信的，都是谁谁谁吃了之后突然感觉自己不一样...
say:2:1621106002:1.male: At first nobody took it seriously. Then someone claimed their meditation suddenly clicked, someone else said they could feel elemental flow clearer... everyone's got some "life-changing" story!
say:2:1621106002:1.female: At first nobody took it seriously. Then someone claimed their meditation suddenly clicked, someone else said they could feel elemental flow clearer... everyone's got some "life-changing" story!

say:3:1621106003:1.text: And once the stories spread, that was it. Boom. Demand exploded. If you're trying to buy now, you're late. Supply can't keep up anymore!
say:3:1621106003:1.source_cn: 于是就一个传一个，现在你想买？晚了，所有人都在吃，现在...
say:3:1621106003:1.male: And once the stories spread, that was it. Boom. Demand exploded. If you're trying to buy now, you're late. Supply can't keep up anymore!
say:3:1621106003:1.female: And once the stories spread, that was it. Boom. Demand exploded. If you're trying to buy now, you're late. Supply can't keep up anymore!

say:4:1621106004:1.text: You have to line up for it... oh, wait... even lining up doesn't guarantee you'll get any. Sounds crazy, right?
say:4:1621106004:1.source_cn: 你得排队，噢不……排队都不一定买得到，听上去是不是很疯狂？

say:6:1621106005:1.text: Of course. I've been on it for over two weeks. The first few days were a bit... well, never mind that!
say:6:1621106005:1.source_cn: 吃，当然吃了，已经吃了两个多星期，刚开始吃有点……这不重要！

say:7:1621106007:1.text: What matters is the effect. And yeah, it works! You feel... better. More awake. More everything!
say:7:1621106007:1.source_cn: 重点是——效果……？效果当然是不错的！吃了之后感觉整个...

say:8:1621106008:1.text: So if you're not taking it, that's on you. Don't blame the jelly.
say:8:1621106008:1.source_cn: 所以啊……你不吃，是你的问题，不是甜甜冻的问题。
